Vibrant, practical, and effortlessly chic, the Winona Bucket Bag from Sarah & Stone is my go-to summer essential. Whether I'm beach hopping or running errands, she's the perfect companion. Made from eco-friendly woven straw and the perfect shade of pink, she's lightweight, so spacious, and super versatile. Wear it crossbody, over the shoulder, or my personal fave, the easy carry handle. Available in four gorgeous colors, this bag completes every summer vibe. Honestly, if you've been searching for the perfect bag that's stylish and sustainable, check out the Winona at Sarah & Stone today.

I bought this bag for one vacation, and now I use it everywhere. I was looking for a cute summer bag that didn't feel bulky or boring, and that's when I found the Winona bucket bag. The woven straw design instantly gives that vacation vibe, but what surprised me was how much it actually fits. Phone, wallet, sunglasses, keys, everything goes in without weighing me down. I also love that I can switch between the crossbody strap and the shoulder handle, depending on where I'm headed. And with so many colors to choose from, it somehow matches every outfit I throw on.
